# Set-ZbxReport

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a scheduled report.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxReport [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixReport>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixReportStatus>] [-DashboardId <ulong>] [-Period <ZabbixReportPeriod>] [-Cycle <ZabbixReportCycle>] [-Weekdays <int>] [-StartTime <TimeOnly>] [-ActiveSince <DateOnly>] [-ActiveTill <DateOnly>] [-Subject <string>] [-Message <string>] [-User <ZabbixReportUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixReportUserGroupRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A scheduled report sends a PDF of a dashboard by email to users and user groups, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. The Set-ZbxReport cmdlet changes the scheduled reports given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with report.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every scheduled report the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed scheduled reports back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a scheduled report

```powershell
Set-ZbxReport -InputObject 'Weekly ops summary' -Status Disabled
```

Disables the scheduled report Weekly ops summary, so it is not sent until it is enabled again.

### Example 2: Change a scheduled report and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxReport -InputObject 'Weekly ops summary' -Status Disabled -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the scheduled report Weekly ops summary back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixReport>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ulong`: Bound to -UserId (ByPropertyName), -DashboardId (ByPropertyName).
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName), -Subject (ByPropertyName), -Message (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixReportStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The report status values: ZBX_REPORT_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixReportPeriod`: Bound to -Period (ByPropertyName). The report period values: ZBX_REPORT_PERIOD_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixReportCycle`: Bound to -Cycle (ByPropertyName). The report cycle values: ZBX_REPORT_CYCLE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `int`: Bound to -Weekdays (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `TimeOnly`: Bound to -StartTime (ByPropertyName).
- `DateOnly`: Bound to -ActiveSince (ByPropertyName), -ActiveTill (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixReportUserRequest[]`: Bound to -User (ByPropertyName). users of a ZabbixReportCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixReportUserGroupRequest[]`: Bound to -UserGroup (ByPropertyName). user_groups of a ZabbixReportCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
